column2: [university_student.GetTitledFirstName] stands before you, cap in hand, and asks leave to go to the [university.GetName]. [university_student.GetSheHeCap] wants to read law and history and the natural philosophers, to hear the great masters dispute, and to come home a learned [university_student.GetManWoman]. The masters' fees are not small, and students are known to learn a great deal besides their books.

You have decided to send [university_student.GetTitledFirstName] to a university, in the hope that [university_student.GetSheHe] comes home a learned [university_student.GetManWoman]. Where will you send [university_student.GetHerHim]?
This character is studying at a university and will come home in a few years.

[university_student.GetTitledFirstName] is home from the [university.GetName], and one look is enough. [university_student.GetSheHeCap] smells of the tavern, laughs too loud and calls for wine before noon. It makes you wonder how [university_student.GetSheHe] ever passed an examination.

[university_student.GetTitledFirstName] is home from the [university.GetName], and changed. [university_student.GetSheHeCap] is wiser, surer of [university_student.GetHerHis] own mind, and full of things you never knew. The masters taught [university_student.GetHerHim] well.

[university_student.GetTitledFirstName] is home from the [university.GetName] with [university_student.GetHerHis] studies finished, but they have taken a great deal out of [university_student.GetHerHim]. Too many sleepless nights over the books have left [university_student.GetHerHim] grey and joyless.
It cannot have been that hard.

[university_student.GetTitledFirstName] is home from the [university.GetName], and not alone. [university_student.GetSheHeCap] has found a spouse among the students' lodgings and brought [university_student.GetHerHis] new family home to meet you.

[university_student.GetTitledFirstName] is home from the [university.GetName], dragging [university_student.GetHerHis] feet. The cities are full of fevers and the students' lodgings are full of the cities' worst. [university_student.GetSheHeCap] will need to rest a long while.

[university_student.GetTitledFirstName] is home from the [university.GetName] with three carts of books behind [university_student.GetHerHim] and a head full of more. [university_student.GetSheHeCap] loved every day of it, and talks of nothing else.
I doubt they will all fit in the library.

[university_student.GetTitledFirstName] is home from the [university.GetName]. Having heard some of [university_student.GetHerHis] stories of wine, dice, duels and the daughters of innkeepers, you decide a student's life must be quite something.

[university_student.GetTitledFirstName] has done better than anyone hoped. [university_student.GetSheHeCap] is home from the [university.GetName] a master of the old sorcery of Araby, with the flames of the desert at [university_student.GetHerHis] fingertips. A scholar of such learning will bring great honour to the family.
A thesis written at a university of the Old World and thought worthy of binding by its masters. The margins are full of the author's later corrections.
